title: Valentine wish page: Yes/No prompt, evasive No, celebration overlay, and photo gallery

requirements.summary: Replace the hero single CTA with a clear Valentine wish prompt and two actions (Yes/No).
acceptanceCriteria: The hero section shows a primary Valentine wish question/message and exactly two visible actions labeled “Yes” and “No”.
The previous single hero CTA (“Explore Memories”) is no longer the primary interaction shown in the hero section.

file_operations.description: Update the hero section to render the Valentine wish question and two actions (Yes/No) instead of the single CTA. Use the shadcn-ui Button component for the actions (Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing).
Add/adjust styles for the new hero wish prompt layout, including a dedicated button container that will serve as the bounded area for the evasive No button movement.

requirements.summary: Implement an evasive No button behavior via useEvasiveButton hook with viewport-safe constraints and reduced-motion fallback.
acceptanceCriteria: On desktop, when the pointer approaches/hover-starts on the “No” button, the button relocates to a different position within a defined container without leaving the viewport.
On touch devices, the first tap attempt on “No” causes it to move (i.e., it should not be trivially clickable).
The “No” button movement is constrained so it never overlaps the “Yes” button and never becomes permanently unreachable.
When `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce` is enabled, the “No” button does not animate evasively; instead it remains stable (or uses a minimal, non-animated fallback).

file_operations.description: Implement the useEvasiveButton hook to manage evasive positioning for the “No” button within a provided container, including constraints to stay within bounds, avoid overlap with the “Yes” button, support hover-approach and touch-first-tap behaviors, and provide prefers-reduced-motion fallback.

Wire the useEvasiveButton hook into the Valentine wish action area: define a bounded container, attach the required refs/handlers to the “No” button and container, and ensure No cannot overlap the Yes button.
Add styles for the evasive button container and positioning (e.g., relative container + absolutely positioned No button). Ensure focus-visible and mobile tap targets remain accessible.

requirements.summary: Show a dismissible celebration overlay on Yes click with distinct confetti/crackers burst, sparkles/lights background, and a sweet acceptance message, with reduced-motion alternative.
acceptanceCriteria: Clicking “Yes” triggers an on-screen celebration layer (confetti/crackers burst + sparkles/lights effect) that is visibly distinct from the existing floating hearts/background particles.
After clicking “Yes”, a sweet message is displayed prominently in the page content (English).
The celebration overlay can be dismissed automatically after a short duration or via an explicit close action, and it does not block scrolling/interaction indefinitely.
When `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce` is enabled, the celebration uses a reduced-motion alternative (e.g., static sparkles/glow + message without heavy motion).

file_operations.description: Implement CelebrationOverlay to render a temporary, dismissible overlay with a confetti/crackers-style burst plus sparkles/light background (using static assets including frontend/public/assets/generated/valentine-bokeh-sparkles-overlay.dim_1920x1080.png). Include an explicit close action and an optional auto-dismiss timer, and implement prefers-reduced-motion alternative. Use shadcn-ui Button if a close button is used (Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing).

Add Yes-click state to trigger CelebrationOverlay, show the sweet acceptance message prominently after Yes, and ensure the overlay can be dismissed or auto-dismisses without blocking interaction indefinitely.

Add styles/animations for the celebration overlay layer (z-index, backdrop, burst effects, sparkles glow) and reduced-motion variants to keep visuals distinct from existing floating hearts/background particles.

requirements.summary: Add a responsive Valentine photo section below the main interaction using static generated frontend assets.
acceptanceCriteria: The page includes a dedicated photo area showing at least 3 images.
Images are loaded from `frontend/public/assets/generated` (or other frontend static public path) and rendered directly by the frontend.
The photo layout is responsive (1 column on small screens, multi-column on larger screens) and visually consistent with the Valentine theme.

file_operations.description: Add a photo section below the main Yes/No interaction that renders at least 3 static images sourced from config. Use the generated assets: frontend/public/assets/generated/valentine-photo-1.dim_1200x800.png, frontend/public/assets/generated/valentine-photo-2.dim_1200x800.png, frontend/public/assets/generated/valentine-photo-3.dim_1200x800.png.
Add config entries for the Valentine photo gallery (image paths + optional captions/alt text) using the required generated filenames under frontend/public/assets/generated.
Add responsive gallery styling (1 column on small screens, multi-column on larger screens) with a Valentine/polaroid-card aesthetic consistent with the existing theme.

requirements.summary: Centralize all new Valentine wish-flow copy in valentineConfig and render those English strings from the config.
acceptanceCriteria: All newly introduced Valentine wish text is sourced from `valentineConfig` (not hardcoded in the component).
All displayed copy for this flow is English.

file_operations.description: Move/introduce all new wish-flow copy into config (wish question, Yes/No labels, sweet acceptance message, and any helper text). Also add the overlay/background asset path for frontend/public/assets/generated/valentine-bokeh-sparkles-overlay.dim_1920x1080.png so the UI can reference it consistently.
Update ValentinePage to read and render the wish-flow copy (question, Yes/No labels, helper text, acceptance message) exclusively from valentineConfig in English.
